versions.statement: Linear的用户满意度整体较好，综合评分为4.3/5星，用户普遍认为其界面出色、集成丰富、功能强大且易于使用，但也存在功能单一、排序选项不足等局限性。

positives: Linear helps our team stay aligned on assignments, prioritize tasks effectively, and maintain visibility
great user interface & all the available integrations with linear
Very simple product to use with powerful project management functionality
negatives: I sometimes wish I could order by different criteria, like latest added, due date
The simplicity or lack of features is a downside
